title: NullPointerException in ManifestLoader.loadFromPath
body:
Loading my manifest crashes:

```text
Exception in thread "main" java.lang.NullPointerException
	at com.example.orbit.manifest.ManifestLoader.loadFromPath(ManifestLoader.java:57)
	at com.example.orbit.cli.ImportCommand.run(ImportCommand.java:31)
```

The file exists. What is wrong?
author: asker

answers.body:
`loadFromPath` returns null for relative paths when the working directory differs. Pass an absolute path:

```java
Manifest m = ManifestLoader.loadFromPath(
    Path.of("/etc/orbit/manifest.yaml"));
```
answers.author: dana

answers.body: Make sure the YAML file is not empty; an empty document also produces this NullPointerException.
answers.author: li
